LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_SpringFlow.label: flower decree
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_SpringFlow.description: The initial score group. Qinghe already knows Spring Flow; this node only unlocks the Flower Decree score group.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chuanhun.label: soulpiercer
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chuanhun.description: Unlocked by "Feihua Jueyu". Creates a sonic burst at a distant target location, stunning targets in the area and dealing psychic damage.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Shuangyuejing.label: frost moon mirror
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Shuangyuejing.description: Unlocked by "Duanqiao Canxue". Summons a circular ice curtain that freezes and absorbs hostile projectiles passing through it.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Gaoshan.label: Gaoshan
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Gaoshan.description: Unlocked by "Gaoshan". Increases Divine Protection shield capacity and Flower Decree maximum.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Liushui.label: Liushui
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Liushui.description: Unlocked by "Liushui". Increases Divine Protection recharge speed.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chunjiang.label: Chunjiang
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Chunjiang.description: Unlocked by "Chunjiang". When Divine Protection takes heavy damage, caps the shield damage from a single hit.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_DivineGrace.label: divine grace
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_DivineGrace.description: Qinghe's mastery node. Each level deepens her own cultivation; concrete effects are applied by Qinghe's passive systems.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Yingyue.label: Yingyue
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Yingyue.description: Unlocked by "Yingyue". Increases the available charges of Divine Blessing.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_NishangDance.label: Nishang Dance
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_NishangDance.description: Unlocked by "Nishang Dance". Allows Qinghe to spend Flower Decree to enter Flower Dance.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Jueying.label: Jueying
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Jueying.description: Unlocked by "Jueying". Allows Qinghe to use Leaping Shadow, choosing a direction after landing to strike in a cone.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Luoshenfu.label: Luoshen Fu
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Luoshenfu.description: Unlocked by "Luoshen Fu". Enables spouse-related Luoshen Fu effects.
